name: auto-route
description: Routes Claude Code by the ask: a routing table and agents for subagent work, and simple questions moved to Haiku or Sonnet.

haikuUpTo.title: Chat questions on Haiku
haikuUpTo.description: A plain question (not about code) runs on Haiku while the session context is under this many tokens. 0 turns it off. Above 100000 Haiku costs more than a warm Opus cache.

sonnetUpTo.title: Technical questions on Sonnet
sonnetUpTo.description: A technical question that asks for no change runs on Sonnet while the session context is under this many tokens. 0 turns it off. The first switch writes the whole context to Sonnet's cache, so in a long session it costs more than staying on Opus.
